name: smwmusic-doraemon-nobita-to-yousei-no-kuni-magical-powerup
title: Doraemon: Nobita to Yousei no Kuni - Magical Powerup
description:
Doraemon: Nobita to Yousei no Kuni is a game obviously based on Fujiko F. Fujio's phenomenal Doraemon manga, which has become a hit in not only its native Japan, but also in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, India, Vietnam, South Korea, China, Spain, Portugal, etc.

Basically, this is the song that plays when you get a temporary powerup in the game.

Good for the star powerup.

NOTE: Please be aware that if nothing plays after the star powerup, lower the echo delay or just remove the echo altogheter. Alternatively, in the level music that has this bug, either change "#default" to "#optimized" or just exclude some SMW samples.

This is the unsampled version. The sampled version is available right here
